title: benchprov provenance record
description: One provenance record for one dataset (or one dataset config / language group with uniform provenance) in the Benchmark Translation Provenance registry. A record describes ONE derivation step: how THIS dataset's target-language items came to be, on the evidence cited. Upstream steps belong to the parent dataset's record.

record_id.description: Stable unique id: <dataset-slug>__<language-part>[__<config-slug>]. dataset-slug = dataset.id lowercased, '/' and non [a-z0-9._-] replaced with '-'. language-part = '-'-joined language tags (lowercased, hyphens between subtags kept) or 'multi' when the record covers 4+ languages.

id.description: Canonical dataset identifier. For Hugging Face: 'org/name'. For other hubs: the repository identifier.

revision.description: The dataset revision (git commit sha for HF/GitHub) that the evidence in this record was checked against, or 'unknown' when no revision could be pinned.

config.description: Optional dataset config/subset name when the record applies to one config only.

root_benchmark.description: Benchmark family name. MUST be a key of registry/families.json (validator-enforced; not a schema enum so families can grow without a schema bump).

target_languages.description: Languages whose items this record's provenance facts describe. All listed languages must share the same provenance facts; split records when facts differ per language.

source_language.description: Language the items were translated/converted FROM (this derivation step only). 'not_applicable' when derived_from.kind is not translation_of/script_conversion_of; 'unknown' when the step is a translation but the source language is unevidenced.

kind.description: This dataset's own derivation step. translation_of: items translated from the parent's items. script_conversion_of: deterministic script/orthography conversion of the parent's items. subset_or_filter_of: items selected/filtered from the parent without re-translation. modeled_on: new items written or generated in the family's style (no item-level derivation). aggregation_of: combines several parents (list them in note). none: an original benchmark, root of its family. unknown: derivation unevidenced.

parent_id.description: Identifier of the immediate parent dataset (same convention as dataset.id), or null when kind is 'none', or when kind is 'modeled_on'/'aggregation_of'/'unknown' with no single identifiable parent.

translation_type.description: How the target-language item text of THIS dataset came to be, at this derivation step. machine: automated translation (NMT or LLM). human: translated by humans. hybrid_machine_post_edited: machine translation whose OUTPUT TEXT was then edited by humans (distinct from verification, which checks without necessarily editing all items). script_conversion: deterministic transliteration/script conversion. lm_generated: items generated in the target language by a model (not translation of parent items). native_original: items natively authored in the target language(s) by people. mixed: methods differ within this record's scope and cannot be split further on the evidence. unknown: no evidence of method.

engine_or_translator.description: Named engine, model, tool, or translating party for this step (e.g. 'gpt-3.5-turbo', 'Google Translate API', 'OpenCC', 'European Commission DG Translation', 'professional translators (unnamed vendor)'). 'unknown' when unevidenced; 'not_applicable' only for native_original records.

human_verification.description: Whether the final target-language items were checked by humans (this step). full: all items stated as human-reviewed/QA'd (includes human translation with an explicit QA/verification step). partial: a stated subset or sample was reviewed. per_item_flags: the dataset itself ships a per-item field marking which items were human-checked (per_item_provenance required). none: the creators' own account of the full process affirms no human check (an affirmative reading of a complete method description; silence is NOT none). not_applicable: only for native_original records. unknown: no evidence either way.

license.description: Declared license of THIS dataset, verbatim from hub metadata or card (e.g. 'mit', 'cc-by-4.0', 'llama3.1'). Recorded as declared; benchprov does not normalize or interpret licenses. 'unknown' when nothing is declared.

field.description: Name of the per-item column carrying provenance/verification flags (e.g. 'is_annotated', 'translation_method').

claims.description: Evidence binding for the six core claim dimensions. Every core field's value must be justified here.

completeness.description: known_core_claims / applicable_core_claims, rounded to 4 decimals. known = claim status in {verified, name_only, conflicting}; applicable = 6 minus claims with status not_applicable. Deterministically recomputed by the validator; a stored value that disagrees is an error.

provenance_state.description: conflicting: any core claim has status 'conflicting' (takes precedence). complete: completeness == 1.0. minimal: completeness == 0.0. partial: otherwise.

method.description: manual: a person read the evidence and filled the record. assisted: an AI system read the evidence and filled the record under human direction (disclosed).

languageTag.description: BCP-47-style tag: lowercase 2-3 letter language subtag, optional titlecase 4-letter script subtag, optional region (2 uppercase letters or 3 digits). Examples: bn, kk, kk-Cyrl, zh-Hant, pt-BR, es-419.

status.description: verified: directly supported by at least one substantive evidence item (dataset_card, hub_metadata, paper, repo_code, dataset_content, external_page). name_only: supported only by dataset naming (weak; e.g. 'nllb' in the dataset id). unknown: no evidence found (field value must be 'unknown'). not_applicable: the dimension does not apply to this record (field value must be 'not_applicable'). conflicting: cited evidence items disagree; all positions preserved in 'conflicts'.

evidence.description: Evidence ids supporting the field's primary value. May be empty only for status unknown / not_applicable (an 'unknown' claim MAY cite evidence of absence with a note).

conflicts.description: Alternative values attested by other evidence. Required non-empty iff status is 'conflicting'.

type.description: dataset_card: prose of the dataset's README/card. hub_metadata: structured hub metadata (YAML front matter, API tags). paper: published paper or preprint. repo_code: source code or data files of a repository. dataset_content: fields inside the dataset items themselves. external_page: an announcement/blog/documentation page. name_only: the dataset's own identifier/naming.

url.description: Prefer revision-pinned URLs (e.g. .../raw/<sha>/README.md) so the evidence is immutable.

quote.description: Short verbatim excerpt carrying the fact. Keep minimal.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the retrieved document bytes, when captured.

hub_revision.description: Hub git revision the evidence was read at.
